description_en: Queries the metadata of a specified data source

name: GetDataSourceMeta

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the ID

parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source
parameters.name: datasource_name

parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The environment in which the data source resides. Valid values:

*   0: development environment
*   1: production environment

目标数据源所属的环境。取值如下：
- 0：开发环境。
- 1：生产环境
parameters.name: env_type
